name: @rotaris/providers
description: Model providers (ADR-0028, ADR-0029, ADR-0030, ADR-0032; domain 04): the frozen six-record catalogue and its integrity check, the credential store with its platform protection adapter and adjacent lock, generic HTTP discovery, deterministic slot assignment, the provider snapshot (`project_settings.yaml`) behind the secret screen, and the API-key sign-in flow.
